博雅智城CitySPS平台

北京大学赵鹏军教授团队研发的博雅智城·CitySPS 平台（city simulating & planning system，CitySPS），以“城市计算引擎”为内核，构建面向城市与区域治理的智能决策系统，基于时空大数据等多源数据库，量化解析城市土地、交通、人口、产业等子系统的运行状态、发展趋势及其相互作用规律，以“城市全系统计量模型”为技术内核，融合城市机理模型（“白箱模型”）和数据驱动模型（“黑箱模型”），实现城市系统的精确计量、精准预测和精细模拟。该平台具有面向决策的平台定位、全面系统的原理架构、量化精确的方法等主要优势。

从数据、信息、知识和智慧等四个方面赋能CIM（城市信息模型，city information modeling），为面向五级三类国土空间规划实施监测的TIM(国土空间信息模型,territory information modeling）提供城市模型与模拟技术。

平台操作演示

重点介绍CitySPS平台五大功能模块（城市要素推演、城市决策模拟、城市状态监测、城市智能预警及城市数据服务）的使用流程及方法，并提供视频操作演示，便于用户快速了解并使用本平台。

# Smart City Tech for businesses

Explore the Open Digital Platform, an award-winning platform that integrates various district management operations.

Last updated 15 May 2026

## Open Digital Platform (ODP): A powerful smart city operating system of the future

ODP is a government-developed smart city operating system for managing various urban functions through real-time data integration.

Drives Singapore's Smart Nation ambitions by enabling seamless integration of sensors and systems.

Aims to achieve 50% less manpower and 30% lower energy consumption.

Serves as the digital backbone for the Punggol Digital District (PDD), Singapore's first smart and sustainable district.

---

In order for us to build a truly Smart Nation, we need to constantly push the envelope. In this regard, we're proud to have partnered with JTC and developed the Open Digital Platform (ODP), a proprietary and one-of-its-kind smart city operating system that integrates various district management operations.

Boasting digital twin capabilities, the ODP can manage district cooling, security, car park systems and more, and even make robotic automation a reality.

Already an award-winning technology, the ODP serves as the digital backbone of the upcoming Punggol Digital District (PDD). Streams of data are collected in real-time to help facility managers, security personnel, and the like deliver seamless estate services and optimise critical operations.

## Why use ODP?

The ODP offers the following benefits for users:

Easily collaborate with your contributors in a trusted, open environment.

Test-bed your solutions in risk-free, virtual simulations before deploying them.

Gain visibility over all systems and the ability to enable remote monitoring and control.

Review and analyse historical data, make improvements and create solutions to address bottlenecks.

Get real-time analyses and responses, such as automatic switch-offs for devices that are no longer in use.

## What's the latest on ODP?

Ahead of its 2024 rollout in PDD, the ODP has already been deployed at The JTC Summit and Woodlands North Coast since 2022 and 2023 respectively. We are also looking to enhance the platform so that it can be scaled up to become the Singapore government's default smart facilities management solution.
